paragraphs.heading: The foundational verse
paragraphs.edited: In 1 Peter 3:15, Peter wrote this: "But in your hearts, set apart Christ as Lord. Oftentimes, when we're talking about things like apologetics, this verse is the foundational verse that everyone seems to cite. Why? Well, because it is in this verse that we get the idea of apologetics.

paragraphs.heading: Is apologetics necessary?
paragraphs.edited: Now, it is important to remember that some people might not really think that this idea of apologetics is all that necessary. In fact, some might even say it's dangerous, and they might even look to passages like 1 Corinthians chapter 2, where Paul gives this idea that it is not by human wisdom or human power that he comes to the Corinthian church — that he didn't come with wise and persuasive words.
